module: Starting template for writing a new flowgraph node (name "New Node Template"). It shows how to declare name, description, color/icon/category/tags (in comments) and a C.pinSchema containing an example input and output pin for each type: flow, number, bool, string, vec3, quat, color, table, any and a multi-type pin ({'number','bool'}). The work() method is empty. To be copied by a modder, not used in game.
notes: Output pins of type table declare tableType = 'generic'.
Default values shown: number 42, bool true, string 'Text', vec3 {1,2,3}, quat {0,0,0,1}, color {1,1,1,0.5}.

work.desc: Called every frame the node is active; empty in the template. This is where you read the input pins (self.pinIn.x.value) and write the outputs.
